content.value: Suppose, you and your friend are playing a game where there are $\cdot _ { k } ,$ spots. Each spot has balls of same color. Each of you simultaneously picks a (single) ball from each spot and approach forward. You start from first spot and your friend from last spot to first spot. Determine using Turing machine with storage if both of you have chosen balls of same color in same sequence when you meet at the middle spot.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
